status: verified design; executable extraction deferred until rollback closure

matching_recovery.minimal_shape: one native Celery recovery task reusing _run_pending_impl and _run_profile_impl; no new service layer
matching_recovery.semantic_change: select every tenant only through profiles.projection_active; remove swissjob-shadow consumer lookup, legacy users lookup, inactive_user_refs and shadow_change_log dependence
matching_recovery.configuration: rename CORE_SHADOW_PROJECT_EVERY_S to CORE_MATCHING_RECOVERY_EVERY_S; do not retain unrelated CORE_SHADOW settings
matching_recovery.tests_to_rehome: recovery signal by revision and corpus generation, attempt watermark, no-vector skip, deterministic fairness, all-consumer coverage, bounded drain and expired ticks

profile_erasure.minimal_shape: move the FK-safe implementation and table tuple directly beside erase_owned_profile; remove its lazy shadow import
profile_erasure.preserve: scrub_capture while retained shadow_change_log exists; scrub_portfolio_manifests; lock and receipt order

delivery_health.minimal_shape: a cheap check_health task opens one session, calls jobhunt_core.delivery.stats, logs alert records and returns current values; no historical metric table or percentile machinery
delivery_health.tests_to_reuse: delivery.stats pending-age and dead-letter tests plus one native task alert/no-alert test

ndcg.minimal_shape: keep the constant and three-line helper local to their sole remaining consumer

deletion_gate: only after capture/slot retirement, post-stop native 17/17 round, production releases, formal rollback closure and the native replacements above are green
non_goals: do not move capture projection code
do not create generic recovery, health or erasure service layers
do not drop historical tables in the application cleanup release
